rationale: Load-bearing TokenKey DI registration and handler wiring that live in upstream-shaped hotspot files. These struct fields and Wire providers are the only thing connecting TK handlers to the application — they compile cleanly if dropped, so an upstream merge can silently deregister entire TK surfaces (admin tiers, pricing catalog, trial provisioning, compliance gate) unless preflight anchors their literal presence.

sentinels.rationale: Retain executable scope parity, no-success-on-conflict, and credential redaction regressions.
Gateway-selected account identity must reach the worker. Both call paths are verified by the focused regression.
Keep the native and Messages account-header behavior regression.
Both ordinary account edits and credentials updates must preserve current runtime and cannot revoke a live worker lease.
The shared DTO/audit/merge credential owner must include browser sessions.
Preserve the regression proving compact warm-account references drive maintenance and the captured image-ratio RPC mapping.
Protect read-only maintenance polling and imported sessions against stale editors.

TK compliance gate on admin page-list endpoint: setting-gated middleware that blocks admin page listing when compliance mode is enabled. This is a single-line insertion in an upstream-shaped file — trivially lost on merge, compiles cleanly without it, but silently disables the compliance guard on the admin pages route.

TK setting fields for canonical OAuth hardening toggles (ingress strict + haiku mimicry) and the cold-start diff helper call site. These are woven into the upstream-shaped GetSettings/UpdateSettings response/request structs and the settings diff function — dropping them compiles cleanly but silently removes the admin UI's ability to toggle canonical OAuth guards and loses cold-start setting change audit trail.

The generated server graph must inject one capability owner into both native gateway handlers. Losing either setter creates protocol-specific drift while the capability service and authenticated UI endpoint continue compiling.

Generated production DI evidence for the UniversalCapabilityService and both gateway projections. AdminHandlers must retain the supplier-source management owner. Removing this field together with its route wiring can compile cleanly while silently deleting the only supported operations surface.

Generated production DI evidence that the Antigravity VALIDATION_REQUIRED counter reaches RateLimitService. The penalty ladder degrades fail-open by design: with a nil counter it silently falls back to the pre-fix single 30-minute cooldown, so a Wire regeneration that drops this argument compiles, passes every unit test (the ladder tests inject their own stub), and leaves production back on the infinite-replay behaviour with no visible signal.
